ambiguity.detail: An abrupt violent ambush happens in the cold open without immediate explanation of who is fighting whom.
Juliana prays to keep 'him' safe, leaving the viewer guessing whether it refers to her husband Alexander.

verdict.hook_line: The driver leaps off the cart, striking the sentry across the chest, seizing his neck, and tackling him violently against the wooden carriage wheel.
verdict.viewer_takeaway: An imprisoned woman resolves to protect her secret husband at all costs just as church bells signal a fateful wedding day.
verdict.why_it_works: Opens with explosive physical violence to stop the scroll, then transitions into deeply emotional, high-stakes prison melodrama.
